## Audit report — pi-goal-list-loop-audit

**Objective**: fix HIGH finding — byte-index string slicing (`&reason[..47]`, `&ev[..37]`, `&reason[..37]`) in the goal-metrics commit-message builder panics on multi-byte UTF-8.

**Verdict on substance**: the fix is real and end-to-end verified.

- **Pre-fix bug confirmed**: `git show bba4d57^:src/sync.rs` shows the literal buggy code `format!("{}...", &reason[..47])` guarded only by `reason.len() > 50` — exactly the finding.
- **All three sites converted**: sync.rs:2890 (`pause_reason`, `chars().take(47)`), 2926 (`ev`, `chars().take(37)`), 2955 (`skip_reason`, `chars().take(37)`), matching the report.rs:3729 convention. Grep for `&reason[` / `&ev[` / `[..NN]` in the builder region returns zero live matches (only a comment).
- **Bonus deeper fix verified**: c06853e converts `extract_goal_metadata`'s JSON-end finder from `chars().enumerate()` + byte-slice to `char_indices()` + `c.len_utf8()`, closing the same panic class one level down.
- **Regression test is meaningful, not scaffold**: `test_goal_metrics_multibyte_utf8_no_panic` (sync.rs:4457) writes a real goal file with emoji + 22 CJK chars (~70 bytes) pauseReason and emoji evidence/skipReason, runs `compute_blast_radius` end-to-end, asserts `PAUSE:`/`EVIDENCE:`/`SKIPPED:` fragments survive and truncation ≤50 chars. I ran it: **1 passed, 0 failed**.
- **Minor discrepancy, not blocking**: the completion summary attributes the truncation conversion to c06853e, but blame shows it landed in parent commit bba4d57; c06853e holds the JSON-end fix. Both are on main by the same identity in the same session, and the findings box cites c06853e (the substantive second commit) — substance unaffected.
- **Reject-class check (v0.31.9)**: the regression test invokes `compute_blast_radius` directly on a temp repo; no test-runner recursion anywhere. N/A.
